publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Compared with the traditional ACIDC traction load, the AC-DC-AC traction load has its unique feature. The power electronic device brought by it certainly will have an effect on the power quality of the grid. The principle and modeling of the typical AC-DC-AC electric locomotive - CRH2 and its tractive power supply system is studied in this paper. The utility model of CRH2 and the Guilin power network is built based on the PSCAD/EMTDC which is a kind of the electromagnetic transient simulation software. The regional power grid is built, and the influence on the power quality of the Guilin grid caused by CRH2 is analyzed and verified by simulation. Finally, the treatment scheme of the problem of the power quality is presented in this paper.

articleTitle: Research on reliability cost-benefit analysis and optimization for distribution network planning based on multi-measures decomposition
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper proposes a distribution network reliability cost-benefit analysis and optimization method. When carrying out the distribution network planning to improve the reliability of power supply, through analyzing a variety of major reliability improvement measures, each measure's reliability cost-benefit analysis curve decomposed can be obtained. Then the curves corresponding to all the measures are combined, and then using the classic power supply reliability cost-benefit analysis theory to develop a reliability optimization strategy considering a variety of measures combination. Using this strategy, the best reliability optimization path of cost-benefit including multi-measures can be selected from the combined curves. The path can be further broken down into the actual investment of each optimization measure, and thus the scale of each measure can be obtained through the investment. Finally considering the actual situation of distribution network, the measures are transformed into some specific projects, and the most economical and reasonable optimization scheme is obtained to achieve a certain improvement of reliability, and realize the efficient control of reliability cost-benefit. This method can optimize the regional distribution network and the individual line. It can optimize the investment based on a given reliability target, and also can optimize the reliability based on a given investment level. Through this method, several typical regional distribution network planning projects of Nanjing city are analyzed and optimized, achieving remarkable economic benefits in practical applications.

articleTitle: Current status and improvement of the legal system of electricity in China
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Since the Electricity Law, which is the basic law of electricity in China, entered into force from 1996, the electricity industry in China has embarked on its legalization, and the legal system of electricity in China has almost been formed after the development of almost 20 years. However, with the development of market economy and the deepening of the reform concerning the legal system of electricity, various problems that has been existing in the legal system of electricity in China become increasingly prominent which are in urgent needs to be resolved. This article reviews the current status of the legal system of electricity in China, analyzes its major problems and on the basis of which proposes legal countermeasures or suggestions for developing a sound legal system, namely building the ideology of the rule of law, confirming the legal concept of sustainable development and scientifically construct the framework and content of the legal system of electricity.

articleTitle: A method to diagnose the property of single-phase fault on high-voltage transmission lines
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The key point of adaptive reclosing technique is distinguishing permanent fault and transient fault reliably and immediately. Shunt reactors with a small reactance in the neutral point has being widely used in the transmission system so that it can make sure the arc extinguished occurs in fault point as soon as possible and keep the recovery voltage amplitude in a low level, finally, has a higher success rate of the single phase reclosing. According to the transient fault characteristics on high voltage transmission line, The impact of shunt reactor on each component of recovery voltage is analyzed, it gives the generation mechanism of the beat frequency phenomenon in recovery voltage, what's more, the calculation formula of beat period is deduced. There gives the envelope's equation by structuring the envelope in use of the basis of the recovery voltage's extreme point; According to the distinction in the envelope slop between two different faults, this paper put forwards a new approach in distinguishing the fault's nature based on the envelope slope. A large number of ATP simulations verify, the new method is feasible, which has the advantage of high reliability, short time of judgment and a strong practicability.

articleTitle: Research on reliability evaluation of the distribution grid based on loop outage model
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Recently State Grid Corporation has issued the Implementing Rules of Reliability Evaluation of Transmission System (IRRETS), in which the loop is firstly introduced into the reliability evaluation. Accordingly the reliability evaluation of the distribution grid can be based on loop-outage model instead of the basic elements. The evaluation can be made through three levels: element-loop-system. In the IRRETS, the definition of the loop and the outage category are defined, the reliability indexes are developed on statistics. However, the IRRETS has not addressed how to product reliability evaluation of the distribution grid based on Loop outage model. The reliability evaluation of basic loop and distribution network are developed in this paper based on the concept of loop in IRRETS. the feasibility and accuracy of the algorithm is verified by the simulated results of the IEEE-RTS 79 system. Thus the proposed algorithm based on loop outage model can be used widely in the reliability evaluation of the distribution grid.

articleTitle: The study of the control system of Composite Power quality Regulation Device
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper first analyzes the advantages and disadvantages of all kinds of compensation technology and then puts forward a integrated control strategy of the composite operation of TSC and SVG and its working principle, so we designs and develops the TSC unit and reactive compensation controller. Equipped with the man-computer interface, the main controller has the functions of password login, information acquisition, calculation, process and storage, internal and external communication, and parameter setting. The protection include over-voltage, under-voltage, phase-loss etc. The main controller determines the cooperating relationship between TSC and SVG, and TSC's switching strategy. The simulation result in RTDS can verify the precision of the validity of the control logic, and also can test the filter performance, dynamic response performance of reactive power compensation and protection functions of the protype. Device control system can meet the design requirements. The prototype of this device has finished the type test according to the national standard.

Author Keywords: Network based Composite power quality regulation device

articleTitle: Research and application on power grid contamination flashover pre-warning technology
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The thesis presents the contamination flashover voltage forecast model with the maximum leakage current, ambient temperature, humidity and other multi parameters on the basis of the research conclusion on insulator string contamination characteristics, so as to realize the online monitoring and evaluation on the contamination condition of the power grid. It comprehensively takes the calculation results of 50% contamination flashover probability and the future climate change trend factors into account to establish the power grid contamination pre-warning system, which has been applied to several power transmission channels in Jiangsu power grid and has successfully warned against the potential danger of 500kV No.5298 Line contamination flashover and achieved the excellent effect.

articleTitle: Security research of state cryptographic authentication security chip in smart grid
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Security chip is widely used in security equipment of power distribution and utilization, ensuring information security of control systems in smart grid. The paper analyzes the threat and protection, such as disturbance attack, side channel attack and data transmission attack, which the state cryptographic authentication security chip are faced with in terminals of power distribution and utilization in smart grid. Then this paper concludes that the security chip achieves the security goal.

articleTitle: Electricity consumers' behavior and macroeconomic influence of step tariff policy—An empirical test based on Guangdong province
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Based on the social investigation and monthly power consumption data before and after the implementation of the policy of the east, west, north, and Pearl River delta cities of Guangdong province, this paper has tested the implementation effect of step tariff from consumers' behaviour characteristics and empirical analysis. It has also proposed state space model based on Kalman filter and constructed the general computable equilibrium model (CGE) including energy and environment. Application of the above methods has effectively eliminated the interference from other factors, and provided a scientific method to assess the realistic effect of step tariff policy; CGE model has also measured the macroeconomic impact of step tariff policy from comprehensive dimensions of economic growth, import and export trade, commodity prices, energy and environment..

articleTitle: Applying FFQ algorithm to implement the auxiliary regulation function of SMES in multi-area AGC system
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Due to the influence of technology and management mechanism, it is difficult to implement the Automatic Generation Control (AGC) in multi-area power system. Distributed Artificial Intelligence (DAI) presents a novel idea for coordination optimization control of multi-area AGC. In this paper, quick response characteristic of Superconducting Magnetic Energy Storage (SMES) and coordination skill of Multi-Agent system (MAS) were used to regulate the active power balance and system frequency. MAS with Friend-or-Foe Q (FFQ) algorithm possess the skill to interact autonomously with other MAS, at the same times, it could consider not just in the benefit of itself but whole system. Moreover, coordination control between AGC generators and energy storage devices can be implemented. Simulation results show that MAS can be used to provide power support for multi area system, therefore frequency stability can be assured. Simultaneously, it is also benefit to make more available distribution of power energy among multi areas.

articleTitle: Research on model system architecture of smart distribution grid
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of optimizing operation and control under complicated network connections in distribution grid, and to provide better support for the distribution network running economically and efficiently, the paper constructs an model system structure which includes three model types, six kinds of business models and three levels. The paper also designs a distribution network model library. It includes six sub-model libraries, has functions of scheduling control for each model, input and output, model analysis, user interaction, and can provide user interface for other modules. Model system structure and distribution network model library provide basic support for smart distribution network development of planning, operation, and control. And they have important theoretical and practical significance too.

articleTitle: Standardized modeling for photovoltaic generation system based on parameter identification method
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Photovoltaic power generation is a typical form of distributed generation. Standardized modelling approach for photovoltaic generation system based on parameter identification method is presented in this paper. Detailed simulation modelling methods and models of photovoltaic generation system are introduced, and based on principles of the least squares method, a detailed parameter identification mode is established in the software DlgSILENT. According to the actual structure and parameters, photovoltaic generation station model is created. Comparison of simulation results and actual operation data is presented, which verifies the validity of standardized modelling method. And the universality for the identification parameter method is analyzed, while universal conclusions are presented.

articleTitle: Research on reliability evaluation of the distribution system based on grid asset quality supervision and management system
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: State Grid Corporation has further strengthened the standardization of the safe grid operation and the building of grid asset quality supervision and management system(GAQS MS) with the proposition of “Twelfth Five Year Plan” and “three sets of five”. The GAQS MS realizes the whole-course supervision and management of planning, designing, construction, production and other aspects of the grid. Among them, the user power supply reliability management system provides both important data for power supply reliability assessment and strong support for further reliability management. Based on the GAQSMS, the overall framework of distribution network reliability assessment and the assessment indexes of component and system levels are proposed in this paper. Using the principles of stratifying based on voltage level and dividing as per power supply mode, the distribution system is divided step by step, and the distribution network reliability assessment involving the substation main wiring is completed. In this paper, the minimal-cut-set method commonly used for distribution network reliability assessment is improved. The improved method can not only solve the branch-node mixed cut sets, but also automatically search out related component lists when bus line, circuit breaker, disconnector or other element in the main wiring fails so that the system influence of the expanding failure of the element in the substation main wiring is considered sufficiently. Finally, based on the GAQSMS, using Fortran and C++, the distribution network reliability assessment is completed, and the accuracy of algorithm and procedure is verified through the calculation of actual distribution network.

Author Keywords: grid asset quality supervision and management system

articleTitle: Design of NPP Steam Generator water-level alternate measuring system based on PLC
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Steam Generator (short for SG) water-level controlling system is the most important controlling system in the second loop of PWR Nuclear Power Plant (short for NPP). If this system falls in abnormal operation, the steam generator water-level deviate from the set value. When the water level exceeds the specified limits, it will result in reactor shutdown, and affect the economy of the NPP and rank of WANO. The SG water level controlling system of Qinshan No.1 NPP puts into use in 1994. Due to the limitation of technical level at that time, microcontroller runs at a slow speed and the memory capacity is small. Transient process and bulk data processing will cause the system collapse. In service, proportional integral regulator output saturation occasionally, which cause level out of controlling. Worse still, manufacturer is no longer producing such kind of hardware and technical supports are unavailable at the same time. In order to supply a reliable backup water-level measurement system for operator, when the main Steam Generator water-level control system fails, we design and produce an alternate level measurement system based on Siemens PLC, S7-315.

articleTitle: Research of network model for islanded grid
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In the situation of partition grid splitting, frequency greatly deviates from the rated value. The impact of correcting the fundamental frequency parameters with the changing frequency during the electromechanical transient simulation is analyzed. For engineering application needs, a possible program that fundamental frequency parameters are corrected discretely to obtain better results is proposed, and the feasibility of the program is verified by a test system simulation. Finally, result comparison of correcting the fundamental frequency parameters or not is done by HuaDong partition grid splitting simulation.

articleTitle: Micro Aerial Vehicle OVIAV) research and application in the city distribution networks
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the increasing complexity of city distribution network, power line Inspection and maintenance workload and increasing difficulty. Simply relying on manual inspection force has been unable to meet the demand of the work. Based on advanced science and technology to develop an intelligent patrol aircraft for inspections of power lines in the city. The MAV (Micro Aerial Vehicle) include the application of smart technology in wireless video transmission, air separation distance measured as the air hovering positioning. It can achieve online monitoring and video monitoring of the distribution lines, transformers, pole equipment, conductors, drain wire, insulators, clamps, and fittings run state. Through the practical application of the results showed that the reaction is fast, lightweight, flexible, low-cost advantages of the flying type, and for the first time applied to the city power lines, to fill the blank of the domestic power industry in the city distribution lines air patrol, has certain The practicality and promotion.

articleTitle: The analysis and test on the Or-logic of dual-channel carrier protection for EHV transmission line
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The theory and implementation scheme of an OR-logical carrier protection with optical-fiber and power line carrier dual-channel communication is analyze d in this paper, and corresponding upgrading methods for some main types of carrier protections are introduced, including: OR-logic of main protection function, remote-transmitted order and channel warning logic. Based on the principle of the fiber and carrier dual-channel pilot protection, the scheme is proposed to test on the validity of the or-logic for protection function. Utilizing the real time digital simulation system (RTDS) to simulate the fault in-lout-zone of transmission line, the OR-logic of protection can be verified overall by setting the different operating mode for the fiber and carrier pilot protection. Finally, this or-logic dual-channel carrier protection scheme is applied for a real 500kV transmission project, and the test method is conducted to verify the correctness and validity, which guarantees the project commissioning successful and system operation security.

articleTitle: Wide-range Operation of dc Microgrid with coordinated control
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Recently, Major academic and practical issue of the power system is the Smartgrid. Major term in Advanced Distribution Operation is the Microgrid. In terms of distribution network, the Microgrid is a removable and controllable component that includes the power sources and the loads simultaneously. In general, currently prevalent power sources and loads have DC I/O Interface, so DC Microgrid has several advantages. Many types of units in Microgrid make the control of system more complex and that complexity makes system unstable. Then the proper coordinated control is essential. Due to the inherence, DC Microgrid has only two control object, one is voltage and the other is active power. This paper defines operation mode of DC Microgrid with several DC sources and suggests economic and efficient coordinated control methods. Simulation with PSCAD proves effectiveness.

articleTitle: Switch configuration optimization meeting the requirement of self-healing
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Self-healing is the most important characteristic of the smart distribution system. Through the switch configuration optimization, the distribution network will not only satisfy the requirement of reliability and economy, but also has good self-healing property. This paper firstly proposes the self-healing evaluation index of distribution system, and then proposes the improved adaptive binary particle swarm optimization algorithm to solve the problems of switch configuration optimization meeting the requirement of self-healing, which builds the multi-objective function of self-healing capability and the comprehension cost, and considers the constraint of distribution systems. At last, the test system results verify the rationality of the model and the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Study on stability control of dispatchable grid-connected PV system
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In the context of environmental pollution and energy resources in the growing tension, solar energy as a new type of green and renewable energy has been paid for more and more attention. The most attention focuses on photovoltaic. But the stability of PV (photovoltaic) system output is poor, the grid will seriously affect the power quality. To ensure the normal operation of photovoltaic power generation system, energy storage is indispensable. This paper studies the dispatchable grid-connected PV systems with energy storage system. Bi-directional DC / DC converter as the main control circuit, a practical control charging and discharging strategy is presented, and by simulation to verify. The results show that the proposed control method can effectively stabilize the PV system output power fluctuations and the DC bus voltage, meet the requirements of charging and discharging, and increased charge speed and prolong the service life of battery.

articleTitle: Current status and improvement of the legislation of energy conservation in China
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Energy Conservation Law, adopted in 1997, amended in 2007 and went into effect from 1 April 2008, is an important law in the field of energy in China and it plays a positive role in solving the problem of lacking energy in China. However, as the market economy develops, the current Energy Conservation Law has revealed its defects and insufficiencies that are in urgent need to be amended and perfected when facing the problems occurring during the process of energy production and consumption. This article reviews the changing process of the legislation of energy conservation in China, presents the main content of the current Energy Conservation Law of China, analyzes the major problems of current legislation of energy conservation and proposes legal recommendations for the perfection of the legislation of energy conservation henceforth.

articleTitle: A voltage fluctuation assessment method based on interval arithmetic for wind farm
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Due to the influence of natural factors, the output power of wind farm is fluctuant and random. This would cause voltage drop variation on the line, and then lead to node voltage fluctuation and affect the power quality of public network. Advanced power quality analysers can measure the voltage fluctuation severity accurately, but it couldn't be used for pre-evaluation. Build a relational model between natural factors and wind power to predict the output power of wind turbine, and then pre-estimate the voltage fluctuation by interval arithmetic.

articleTitle: Reliability evaluation for distributed generating system based on state duration sampling method
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper proposed a reliability evaluation algorithm for distributed generating system based on sequential state duration sampling method. The power output fluctuation of distributed resources, chemical reaction constraint of energy storage device, and the power exchange strategy with the utility grid are taken into consideration. The method produces the time-varied status of all the elements in the system according to their failure models and then simulates the system operating situation within a statistical significant of the period. The power outage information in the entire statistical period is recorded and the reliability indices will be calculated then.

articleTitle: Application of enhanced dual-channel line differential protection in China Southern Grid
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In 2008, very rare icing disaster suffered China Southern Grid (CSG). Many transmission lines, substations and ground lines are outage. Measurements had been taken to keep main grid working safely and stably. The experience, especially on protection field, absorbed from this case is introduced in this paper. By complement of public communication network, electric communication is strengthened. To overcome the difficulty that public communication channel can't be used in differential protection, three types of improved differential protection relays are developed. The principle of those relays is explained in detail. In 2012, CSG experiences another ice disaster, the new type protection works perfectly.

articleTitle: Process simulation of Under Frequency Load Shedding (UFLS) based on Matlab with State flow
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In today's electricity market, the power supply enterprises have to face power quality problems. The reducing of power system frequency threaten the safety of power grids. At this time, we have to use the Under Frequency Load Shedding(Hereinafter referred to as the UFLS) device to remove partial load, to restore the system frequency within the level of security. UFLS device, therefore, the correct action or not is directly related to the safe and stable operation of the power grid. Based on Matlab/Simulink, we set up a simulation model to simulate and analyze the process of UFLS of single machine and interconnected system with module (PSB) and State Flow. Using State Flow in power system simulation is not used in the former scientific research. This subject verifies the validity of the logic action of State Flow using on the power system simulation.

articleTitle: An investigation of load model and optimal load distribution of microgrid
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The paper studies the load distribution optimization in microgrid; Exclusive re searches on microgrid operation are required as it is different from traditional power. The accuracy of load model and its parameters have great effect on micro grid system digital simulation results. The paper establishes a load model that can reflect frequency characteristics, and analyzes the load distribution optimization in micro grid. The result of distribution optimization is analyzed using the calculation of power flow.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic wire in the application of high overload traction transformer
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The paper introduced the actual application of the new insulation material magnet in high-overload traction transformer. Firstly, the paper analyzed the overload capacity of traction transformer and the temperature rise, life-span model. Secondly, a comparison with the conventional insulation paper was made in its impact on the transformer oil and hot-point temperature rise. Finally, detailed advice on the traction transformer temperature rise limit was concluded, verified that the material magnet can improve the overload capacity of traction transformer, so that the transformer installed capacity decreased, as well as the operating-costs and the cost of power supply.

articleTitle: Control strategy and its dynamic simulation of energy storage system in microgrid
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: For a micro-grid, the voltage and frequency may fluctuate due to the switch on and off of heavy power loads. In order to relieve the potential fluctuations, the characteristics of the micro-grid are analyzed and a droop control based power control strategy of the energy storage system (ESS) in the micro-grid is proposed in this paper. By adjusting the active and reactive power injection of the ESS, the voltage and frequency can be regulated within acceptable ranges. The proposed scheme is then tested on a dynamic test micro-grid. The simulation result shows that the power control strategy can achieve the objective of stabilizing both voltage and frequency of the micro-grid.

articleTitle: A two-phase electric quantity-based fault location algorithm for power distribution systems
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper proposes a new fault location algorithm based on two-phase voltage and current measured at the power system side for unbalanced power distribution systems. Taking single-phase-to-ground fault as an example, the paper elaborates the algorithm for feeders with and without laterals. A simple feeder in power distribution system and IEEE-13 node power distribution system are used as test systems. The effectiveness and high accuracy of the proposed algorithm have been verified through many Electromagnetic Transients Program (EMTP) simulations.

articleTitle: Research and application on mass data storage replication technology
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the rapid development of information technology, we have already entered the era of big data. Currently the industry has put big data as its core competitiveness in the market, the advent of the era of big data indicates that who grasps data who holds the world. Consequent massive data processing technologies become the focus of research in the field, how to efficiently integrate planning, storage transformation, massive data replication migration become one of the important issues. This paper aims to study the mass data storage data migration technology to meet business continuity, data security, data integrity requirements, while research massive data replication technology based on storage block asynchronous migration method. Then this thesis comparative analysis of the impact of the replication efficiency factors. Finally, combined with the practical application scenarios and test results, this paper propose a reliability solution based on HP CA the replication technology.

articleTitle: A new utility algorithm of processing fault in distribution network based on searching tree
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: According to the structural characteristics of the distribution network, this paper propose an algorithm that based on searching tree for fault section detections, isolation and recovery in distribution system. According to the relationship between each switch contact, the algorithm constructs a tree model of the distribution network, on this basis, search out fault section and find out more than one recovery power pains by using fault information collected by FTUs and DTUs. Algorithm case show that this algorithm is effective to not only single-fault, but also multiple-fault. This algorithm has inhibition ability of distribution terminal error signal, therefore. This algorithm has a high practicability.

articleTitle: Research on the current status of electromagnetic environments around the transformer substations
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper discusses on the current substation of electromagnetic environments around transformer substation in china. And the problems are introduced on the laws, regulations, standards and monitoring method of electromagnetic environments. Then put forward the solving method of problems and prospect application of the management of electromagnetic environments around transformer substation in Tianjin.

articleTitle: Selection algorithm based on correlation analysis with transient information of fault signal in neutral un-effectual grounded system
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: When there happens the single-phase grounding fault in the neutral un-effectual grounded system, the transient ground fault current contains the whole system's fault characteristics. The main component of the transient phase current of health line is capacitive current to ground, considering the affect of the inductance that resist in the system, the phase current of the health feeder is so small that the waveform between its phase current and zero sequence current's transient information shows significant irrelevant, while the waveform of the fault line shows a significant correlation. Taking advantage of this feature of small current system when there occurs the signal-phase fault, the use of correlation analysis and comparison of each line's transient information phase current and zero sequence current correlation can select out the fault line correctly, the article use the MATLAB/SIMULINK simulation verify the correctness of the method.

articleTitle: Application of net profit rate of investment in the selection of feeder automation scheme
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The effect of all different kinds of feeder automation on power supply reliability is analyzed. Specific method of evaluating feeder automation scheme using net profit rate of investment is expounded from the view of practical engineering in this paper. The feeder automation scheme of the city of H is analyzed and calculated. The improved method of production and electricity ratio is used to calculate the loss of outage reduced by implementing feeder automation. The economy of different types of feeder automation in different power supply sections is analyzed and compared, and the optimal feeder automation schemes in different power supply sections are given. The results of the studies are of certain reference significance for the distribution network plan.

articleTitle: The study on distribution network and use-mode of clean energy in the process of new-type urbanization
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Urbanization is an important carrier of China building a moderately prosperous society, promoting new urbanization has greatly increased the demand for energy, as the platform of various types of energy conversion and efficient use, distribution network for the development of new urbanization play the fundamental role. The network structures for a large number of clean energy access, coordination between multi-energy, two-direction flow characteristics of energy are key challenges of restricting the construction of new-type urban distribution network. T his paper introduces the general idea of the research on distribution network and use-mode of clean energy in the process of new-type urbanization. The research strategies, including load forecasting, power supply mode, the power supply capacity assessment, utilization of clean energy, are promoted. It intends to validate research results by selecting North Wuxi & Daichang island, Suqian as the decoration bases.

articleTitle: Analysis on the fault of 2012 South China Grid above 220kV AC system and improvement methods
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: From the fault cause, time and other aspects, this paper firstly statistics and analysis 2012 South China Grid above 220kV AC system fault, and secondly summarizes up the fault character and regularity, and thirdly proposes the improvement proposal based on the data, in order to design, operation and maintenance personnel use.

articleTitle: An alarm management framework for self-healing smart distribution system
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In modern distribution system high efficient, clean, reliable and flexible electricity energy is required to supply to customers. Self-healing distribution network has been raised as one of the most emerging and significant characters for such smart distribution system to cope with all kinds of threatens from inside and outside of the system. Events and alarms are the bases for system status comprehend and decision making. Alarm management is a traditional feature of Supervisor control and data acquisition (SCADA) and distribution management systems (DMS), and key feature for smart self-healing distribution system as intelligent alarm. When events occur in distribution system, too many alarms rush to control center. The alarms are separated and maybe suspicious preventing the understanding of the whole event. In this paper, an alarm management framework is proposed for intelligent alarm processing. Firstly the events and alarms for self-healing smart distribution system are categorized. Then a complex event processing based intelligent alarm processing method is proposed for effective management alarms and events. Finally, example is shown based our framework. and the advantage of alarm management is illustrated. The alarm management framework can not only recognize the event sequence, providing effective intelligent alarm, but also reduce the amount of alarms to process by system operators. facilitating decision making.

articleTitle: Index system for condition evaluation of distribution network based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Since condition monitoring technology is not yet completely developed and corresponding devices require extra investments, it is not economic efficient for distribution network, with massive devices, to be equipped with specialized condition monitoring equipment respectively. Therefore, it is necessary to research condition evaluation technology for distribution equipment based on operation data and previous maintenance records under current circumstance. On this occasion, the paper established a condition evaluation index system for distribution network, adding indices based on operation data and maintenance records on the basis of available guidelines which derive from routing inspections and tests. The proposed index system can provide foundation for future CBM decision-making of distribution network.

articleTitle: A power quality analysis method based on hybrid simulation of electro-mechanical transient and electro-magnetic transient
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In this paper, a power quality analysis method based on hybrid simulation of electro-mechanical transient and electro-magnetic transient is proposed. Using this method, the pollution source and the power grid around it are analyzed using electro-magnetic algorithm, which can simulate the generation of power quality problems and the effect of control measures in detail; the external power grid is analyzed using electro-mechanical algorithm, which can simulation the spread process of phenomena. Compared with tranditional analysis methods, the proposed method retains all the advantages of electro-magnetic transient simulation, and also can take the interaction between power quality problems and power grid into consideration. The principle of the hybrid simulation is presented in the paper, and the applicability of this method to the analysis of power quality problems is discussed. Based on ADPSS hybrid simulation program, the modelling of electrified railway and STATCOM are presented, and two cases are illustrated to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: The study on an algorithm of co-optimization of energy and reserves in Reserve Markets
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: As the revolution of power market, the condition of energy and environment has become serious. It is an urgent problem on how to built a reasonable model of reserve markets. This paper describe the reserves market briefly, and then construct the model of co-optimization of energy and reserves as implemented in reserve markets. In this mode, it is discussed the reserves of generators in the condition of heavy load and light load for all interfaces in the grid, while texting with the penetration of wind power the change of reserve market. As results of them, the way to optimization of energy requirement and demand of reserves is presented. In this way, the social benefit could be maximized and the over capacities of reserves and insufficient of compensation would be improved. Lastly, it is reasonable for power market to dispatch and optimize unified. The co-optimization of energy and reserves play a positive role power system stability and social benefits to proof the advancement of the model.

articleTitle: Research for the fast distance protection of transmission lines based on equal transfer processes
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Taking into account the error caused by differential, two factors' impact on the distance protection algorithm after equal transfer processes are studied, including the sampling rate and cut-off frequency of the low-pass filter. It comes to a conclusion that increasing the sampling rate can reduce the error caused by differential and cutting down the cut-off frequency can reduce the variance of the least square method, which is verified by the ATP simulation and dynamic physical simulation results. Combined with the simulation results, the impact caused by the length of data window is studied by analyzing the performances of the proposed algorithm. By optimizing the sampling rate, the cutoff frequency, and the length of data window, the distance measuring error can be achieved within 5% at approximately 10ms after the fault occurrence.

articleTitle: Transient analysis of network containing nonlinear time-varying mutual inductance
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Acoording to circuit theory and numerical integration principle, a circuit model based on the trapezoidal algorithm is proposed to facilitate the computer's transient analysis of circuit containing nonlinear time-varying mutual inductance,which will make the transient analysis of nonlinear time-varying mutual inductance network as simple as the DC analysis of a LTI resistive network.

articleTitle: Simulation research on photovoltaic grid-connected system
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the rapid development of new energy resources, more and more renewable energy is fed into the grid through grid-connected inverter. A simulation model of PV grid-connected system is built in MATLAB/Simulink, and the output characteristics of the PV cells are analyzed. The P&O method (Perturbation and Observation) is used to achieve MPPT (Maximum Power Point Tracking). A double-closed-loop control strategy including a voltage outer loop and a current inner loop in grid-connected operation and a V/f control strategy in the island operation are proposed. The simulation results show that the system can achieve MPPT of PV cells, which can also realize stable operation. The control strategies proposed in this paper have some reference significance to the actual PV system design.

articleTitle: Investigation of water-tree-retardant rapid detection method for XLPE cables
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Because of the addition of water tree resistant material, TR-XLPE power cable costs about 5%-20% higher compared to the ordinary XLPE. To evaluate the water tree retardant ability of TR-XLPE cable, four kinds of tests are taken: broadband dielectric frequency spectrum test (BDS), differential scanning calorimetry (DSC), AC voltage endurance evaluation and infrared spectroscopy. Variations of water tree retardant for XLPE in before and after aging characteristic parameters are investigated.

articleTitle: A method of evaluating online operating state of transformer
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Transformer online operation state directly influences the operation state of the whole power system. A transformer online operation state assessment method is proposed in this paper. This method is based on history, real-time, future operation data of transformer, and five evaluation models for device, maintenance, state, operation, and plan are established. Six category twenty-five sub-indexes that impact transformer operation are quantified to estimate the transformer online operation state comprehensively. Then comprehensive index is given by analytic hierarchy process, which ensures the safe and economic operation of transformer.

articleTitle: Network based protection based on the peer-to-peer communication—Part III: Research on the protection of the breaker and load switch network structure
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Distribution network automation solution depends on the type of connection switch. This paper proposes a network protection scheme based on the breaker and load switch network: If the connection switch is a breaker, it can cut off the path of fault current when a short circuit fault happens, and can reclose once or several times according to the requirements. If the connection switch is a load switch, it cooperates with its superior breaker and opens the switch on either side of the fault after its superior breaker clears the faults. Then, the contact switch closes automatically. This scheme achieves the goal of isolation fault and load transfer.

Author Keywords: the breaker and load switch network structure

articleTitle: Distribution control area modeling based on CIM
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Division of distribution control area is the foundation of operation, marketing, maintenance and fault analysis. By comprehensively analyzing the critical demands of the operation, control and management in distribution network, distribution control area is modeled based on common information model (CIM), in order to improve the efficiency of the fault diagnosis and optimal dispatching. Taking advantage of meta-modeling theory of CIM, this paper establishes a highly scalable, unified information model. The modeling requirement of static network topology and dynamic traverse is taken into consideration and the distribution control area is regarded as a base unit of business flow and information flow in the operation and management process. Finally, taking outage analysis for example, the accuracy and effectiveness of distribution control area modeling is verified.

articleTitle: Stability control strategy study of Gaoling BTB HVDC project on PSCAD
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The capacity of Gaoling BTB HVDC project reaches 3000MW, while the North China side of the project is weak in structure. It is a typical case of massive DC power feeding into weak AC systems. The study of its stability control strategies is unique. In this paper, a stable operation limit and security control measures after severe faults in the DC and nearby AC system is developed by comparing the simulation results on BPA and PSCAD. The unbalanced DC-AC system results in severe voltage stability problems during the implementation of the strategy. An integrated method of DC power reduction with AC filter fast switching is proposed to inhibit overvoltage and to improve transient stability of the DC-AC system. All the security and stability control strategies has been applied in the Gaoling BTB project.

articleTitle: Design and assessment of distributed energy systems for neighboring buildings
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Thanks to its relatively high overall efficiency, the combined heat and power (CHP) system is recognized to be the most feasible distributed energy resource (DER) technology to cope with the continuing global warming. Although facing a bright future, there are inevitably some barriers against building the penetration of CHP systems. One of which is the unbalanced electricity and heat between the supply and demand sides. This paper aims at discussing the advantages of energy exchanging between neighboring buildings with the adoption of CHP systems. For this purpose, an optimization model has been developed for the optimization of local distributed energy system while taking system energy performance as the objective function. According to the simulation results, the energy exchanging between the buildings may increase the overall system efficiency to some extent.

articleTitle: Discussion on FA scheme based on fault status differential protection
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Some place requires for highly power supply reliability, common feeder automation solution can't meet the requirements, so, we need to restudy the feeder automation solution. This paper involves the FA scheme based on fault status differential protection, by using optical fiber communication to achieve the selectivity of protection, fault location, isolation, power recovery. Finally, through the analysis of a system fault conditions in open-loop and closed-loop operation, the result shows that system could remove fault quickly one-time, breakers no need reclose more times, the impact on the system and power distribution equipment is reduced, non-fault section no need power cutting, greatly improving the quality of power supply.

articleTitle: Study of power system simulator based on the double DQ transformation
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In order to test photovoltaic inverter's LVRT performance, it is needed to design big power grid simulator. In this paper, with Tl's floating-point DSC TMS320F28335 as processor core, dual- 3-phase bridge parallel converter system is built. Grid simulator is composed of controlled rectifier and inverter. In order to achieve an asymmetric form voltage drop, the paper handle set voltages and sampled voltage by double DO decomposition, and get the positive and negative sequence voltage. This article added 100Hz notch in the decomposition process, and achieve the given voltage and negative feedback voltage sequence separation.

articleTitle: Study on characteristics of Fiber Optic Current Transformer and the impact on reliability of protection
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Fiber Optic Current Transformer (FOCT) realizes current measurement by using the Faraday magneto-optical effect. With advantage of unsaturation, wide dynamic range and immunity to electromagnetic interference etc, FOCT is widely used in smart substation and HVDC transmission, so the accuracy of measurement and reliability of long-term operated have become the focus of attention[1-3]. In this paper based on the structure and principle of FOCT, the AC and DC transient response characteristic are analyzed ; the accuracy characteristic and influence factors of FOCT are researched(include Verdet constant, turns of fiber coil, particle nature of light, optical components aging, ambient temperature, magnetic field in space etc), especially impact of peak current on its accuracy, and the influence of fiber stress in its field installation process, correctness of polarity on its accuracy is also studied; furthermore the problem of protection reliability caused by characteristics of digital sampling, fiber installation and polarity is analyzed base on analysis of accuracy and transient characteristics of FOCT, then points out some strategy to deal with it; Finally the measures to improve reliability of FOCT are proposed based on FOCT operation and defects in practical engineering applications.

articleTitle: The differential current calculation of the 110kV double bus single segment connection mode
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper gives detailed analysis to the 110kV bus differential protection's configuration and basic principal under the condition of 110kV main electrical wiring being double bus single segment in the 220kV substations. On the other hand, the calculation formulas of bus bar's differential current are also been analyzed in detail, which are under all kinds of bus coupler and segment switch's operating circumstances. This analysis gives foundation to the timely judgment, finding and discovery of the faults under this connection mode.

Author Keywords: 110kV double bus single segment connection mode

articleTitle: Research on the grid administration of urban distribution Big Data management
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In recent years, businesses are deeply aware of business data integration and IT model is very important. Big Data Theory and the development of related industries promote the informatization process of medical, construction, municipal and other areas. Urban distribution network in the era of Big Data management is not the traditional network operation and maintenance, but an advanced management mode which uses data-based strategies to launch distribution network operation and maintenance, in other words, the future distribution network with large data management will become the core of network management. This paper focuses on talking about the ideas and suggestions of using grid administration to manage urban distribution network's Big Data.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of an integrated Smart Substation laboratory system
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The paper presents design and implementation of an integrated Smart Substation laboratory with flexible structure and multifunction. Comparing with other laboratory, integration and system level are the outstanding characteristics. Integrating resources of physical simulation laboratory, power system dispatch laboratory and power system distribution laboratory by applying bi-directional interface, operation environment similar to various voltage level substations site, such as EMC (Electro Magnetic Compatibility), temperature and humidity, had been constructed through coordination with digital and physical simulation. In addition, system level and component level experimental bed had also been built for the purpose of research, validation, and test in order to satisfy with new requirements in relay protection, time synchronous and network structure, etc. which are employed in substation. The research platform, just like for new energy accessing with grid, etc. had also been launched. The construction better satisfy with the research and test for new technology and equipment which are employed in smart substation.

articleTitle: Study on heat treatment process of alloy 6063 bus welded joints
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Study on the effect of solid solution treatment and aging process on mechanical properties of welded joint of 6063 aluminium alloy, the results show that, for the welded joint of 6063 aluminium alloy, solution treatment at 500 °C for 1h followed by water quenching is an ideal solution system. Artificial aging at 175 °C for 8h is the bes t aging system, as in this treatment produced the highest tensile strength of the joint, a uniform grains, and a more average hardness. In industrialized production may be considered aging at 200 °C for 2h instead of aging at 175 °C for 8h to improve efficiency. Mechanical properties obtained by the two aging system is closer, can meet the power industry standards of alloy 6063.

articleTitle: Fault prediction for power system based on multidimensional time series correlation analysis
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Fault prediction for power equipment allows the maintenance personnel to know the operation conditions and the fault to be occurred in advance so as to reduce the risk of fault and the economic loss. The current fault prediction methods are generally based on physical model or stochastic model, which are used to evaluate the remaining life of equipment. However, in fact, there are many interference factors between grid equipment; therefore, it is very difficult to illustrate the fault characteristics by using an accurate mathematical model. Besides, there exist many problems such as uncertain mathematical model parameters and short prediction period. As such, this paper proposes a fault prediction method based on correlation analysis of multidimensional time series, which normalizes the historical time-series data of nodes in the power equipment network topology, decomposes the time series by using the time series decomposition algorithm, extracts the typical events occurred on the nodes before the key equipment fails by using one time series pattern representation method, and explores the implicit relationship between the indicator trend and the operating conditions of equipment by correlation method, with a purpose of effectively predicting the fault or impact. The test shows that this method can make the best of time series data and take advantage of the capability to analyze and express the uncertainty relation of data mining so as to accurately and effectively predict equipment faults.

articleTitle: The development and technological research of intelligent electrical building
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the popularization of Internet of things technology and the rise of the smart grid concept, a lot of theoretical research and practical exploration have been carried out on intelligent electrical construction at home and abroad. Intelligent building is an important outcome of the application of computer technology in information age, and it is an important part of power segment of smart grid. Through the perfect combination of modern high-tech and building, intelligent building creates a comfortable, safe, economic, efficient, convenient and sustainable development of work and living environment for the user, provides intelligent and interactive electricity services, supplies a convenient management means for managers, reduces the energy consumption and the cost of management for the operators, provides the material basis for the modern property management. At the same time, the development of `three networks convergence' of the State Council is of great significance for promoting the growth of information and cultural industry, improving the level of national economy and social information, contenting people's diversified demand of production and life service, boosting domestic consumption, forming new economic point of growth. This paper explains the basic concepts of intelligent building, describes the significance and development goals of intelligent electricity building construction firstly, then analyzes the current situation of intelligent electricity building, points out the existing problems at present, and discusses the key technology of intelligent building. Finally this paper looks into the distance of the development trend for intelligent building, the developing direction of intelligent building is clear and definite. The basic requirement of intelligent building is intelligent and automated office equipment, high performance communication system, flexible architecture, and automated construction management service. The composition of the basis technical of intelligent building is illustrated in this paper, and it mainly contains modern building technology, modern computer technology, modern communication technology and modern control technology. The equipment and cable security of weak current system for intelligent building must rely on electrical technology. Modern construction technology is a series of theory, technology and behavior norms which is born and developed in the modern construction practice. The core of modern computer technology is distributed computer network technology in parallel. Modern communication technology is the rapid transmission of data, voice, video through wireless and wired communication technology. Modern control technology is mainly about the distribution type of monitoring system. Through research and analysis, this paper thinks that the structure of intelligent building system will be changed by the progress of information technology, and it is need to reconsider and adjust the function, role and service mode of intelligent building system. The simulation technology of intelligent building will change to digital technology, its transmission system will change from proprietary network to IP network. So the system integration is higher, the appearance is more beautiful, the operation is more convenient. Through the establishment of advanced technology, scientific management and integrated highly intelligent management system, intelligent building not only save the consumption of energy source, reduces the waste of resources, cuts down the daily operating costs, but also provides safety, comfortable, fast, efficient high-quality service, good work and living environment for human beings.

articleTitle: The energy management system of the smartgrid characterized by multi-parts interactions
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Security, economy, and efficiency are the major goals of strong SmartGrid, and it is a excellect way that the construction of SmartGrid characterised by multi-parts interactions to get these goals. A new energy management platform for the multi-parts interactive smartgrid is proposed in this paper, which designs the grid's new operation mechanism, consisting the interaction platform of transmission grid and distribution grid, could be the basement for deep perception of all sections of the grids, accurate forecasting, intelligent decision by encouraging clients participate in grid's interaction, inorder to catch up large-scale intermittent renewable energy output adjustment mode. Finally, the structure and design plan of this platform is also proposed in this paper, and its feasibility could be proved by the example of Ningxia Power Grid.

articleTitle: Control strategy of low voltage microgrid based on equivalent reference current control
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Taking the low voltage microgrid with multiple distributed generations as research subject, this paper proposed equivalent reference current control method which is suitable for two operation modes of microgrid based on PQ control method and V/f droop control method. For the amplitude and frequency of voltage, the deviation value between reference value and actual value is introduced respectively into dq axis component of the reference current, distributed generation(DG) have corresponding operation characteristics in two operation modes of microgrid by controlling the deviation value. In the islanded operation mode, DG share the power proportional according to their rating power by different coefficients of the deviation and provide voltage and frequency support for the microgrid; in the grid-connected operation mode, the coefficient of deviation is set to zero to eliminate the influence of deviation on output power and achieve the goal of constant power output. In addition, the reference power transition link which is conducive to smooth reconnection is introduced by controlling the deviation while interconnecting to the distribution grid. This proposed control method can avoid the switch of control methods and insure the smooth transition when operation modes change, and can also effectively improve the dynamic adjustment performance of voltage and frequency in island mode, and achieve the direct power control in grid-connected mode. At the same time, the grid synchronization controller based on this control method is designed to achieve the smooth reconnection of the microgrid. Through three detailed case studies, being operating in grid-connected mode, operating in island mode, and switching operation modes, the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed control strategy are validated by Matlab/Simulink, and two parallel three-phase inverters system is implemented for the experimental demonstration.

articleTitle: Research on IEC 61968 based message design for intelligent operation and maintenance center
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Intelligent operation and maintenance is a novel technology mode of advanced transmission and distribution equipment management that can meet the demand of online monitoring, condition-based maintenance and visual management for equipment, as well as rapid load recovery repair and advanced asset management integration requirements. It serves as one of the most significant contexts to promote the standardized level of power system and for the development of smart grid. An IEC 61968 standard and SOA architecture based information platform infrastructure for the Intelligent Operation and Maintenance Center (IOMC) of Hengqin new district is introduced in this paper. Unified interface and data interaction specifications for the information platform of the IOMC are formulated and regulated according to business needs and process of the IOMC. The defined XSD message format and three message type meet the requirement of data integration and visual display that the IOMC have on automation, production management and GIS system. Thus the enabled panoramic view that monitoring the transmission, substation and distribution system and equipment operation information of the Hengqin new district creates an innovative management mode of the operation of transmission, substation and distribution equipment, which improves the collaboration working ability and efficiency of equipment's operation, maintenance, management and that of typical production business.

articleTitle: Research of islanding detection and islanding protection based on WAN phase comparison
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Study PQ control mode of the inverter-based distributed energy resources(DER), and analyses its system characteristics while DER operating connected with distribution network. When the point of common coupling (PCC) between DER and distribution network is broken and the island formed, analyzed change characteristics of frequency and voltage phase and the influence of unbalanced power in islanding system, especially remarkable phase difference changes will occur between large power bus side and DER side voltage. Based on this the islanding detection and islanding protection method based on WAN phase comparison is proposed, the islanding detection criterion is the voltage phase difference between distribution network bus side and DER side, the synchronous measurement and calculation of voltage phase on both sides are completed by the feeder automation terminals (FTU), and realize information exchange through the rapid communication system. Based on Matlab, established the islanding detection simulation model, experimental results verify the reliability and applicability of the method‥

articleTitle: A quantitative assessment method for source-load interaction
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Flexible load will become valuable means to balance fluctuations induced by renewable energy in the future. It's a key issue to assess the capacity of source-load interaction. This paper analyzes the concept of source-load interaction first. Then an evaluation index system for source-load interaction is proposed in order to effectively reflect the impact of interaction on power grid, which involves two categories: the power flow distribution index and the interaction effect evaluation index. Finally, simulation results based on the IEEE standard 39-bus system are discussed in this paper, illustrating the effectiveness of the proposed index of interaction performance evaluation.

articleTitle: A power communication service classification and optimization management scheme for the distribution network communications network based on the business sense technology
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: As an essential part of smart grid, the demand for smart distribution grid has changed greatly with the access of distributed energy, electric vehicles. This paper analyzes all sorts of communication service demand for smart distribution grid, presents a distribution grid network service classification optimizing management scheme based on business sense, which uses business identification and classification technology to realize network bandwidth and traffic dynamically intelligent control and schedule, provide different network service and guarantee important business's operation perfectly.

Author Keywords: the power service classification and optimization management

articleTitle: Wide-area multi-FACTS coordinated control (MFCC) based on polytopic linear differential inclusion for multiple-load cases
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the wide application of flexible AC transmission system (FACTS) in power system, one of the major directions of FACTS development is the research of multi-FACTS coordinated control based on wide-area measurement system (WAMS). In this study, the wide area centralized coordination control architecture is established. Based on the structure of the dynamic output feedback control and the theory of the polytopic linear differential inclusion, a wide-area multi-FACTS coordinated control algorithm for multiple load cases is proposed. The algorithm is validated in a 4-machine, 2-area system with static var compensator (SVC) and thyristor controlled series capacitor (TCSC). The result shows that the power system successfully runs in strong damping modes in multiple load cases.

articleTitle: Review and prospects of research on risk assessment of power system
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Traditional deterministic methods usually applied to the most severe and low probability events in power system risk assessment, computation results are therefore much conservative accordingly. Considering both probability and their impact of the effects, risk assessment methods can provide comprehensive effect on the whole power system. The status quo related to risk assessment is reviewed. The meaning and main research aspects of risk assessment are discussed, and the risk indexes based on engineering presented besides. The essential flow chart and key problems to be resolved concerning risk assessment of power system are studied.

articleTitle: The vision of smart grid 2.0
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: About the form of future smart grid, there are many opinions which are divergent in the industry. Based on concept of Web 2.0, this paper put forward concept, form, feature and development trend of smart grid 2.0. The main points are: smart grid 2.0 is further fusion with energy technology and information technology, its main characteristic is sharing and interaction; To transformation into a comprehensive energy network is the glorious mission of smart grid 2.0; smart grid 2.0 is an open platform, which will cause innovation on technical and management; smart grid 2.0 is a profound transformation, who can seize this opportunity, who will become the leader of future smart grid.

articleTitle: The research of the power plant and substation grounding network reconstruction Inner Mongolia region
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: As the further growth in electricity using of Chinese urban residents, in order to meet the requirements of the city, more and more 220kV transformer substations have been constructed in the city as distribution substations. the character of such substations are: 220kV and 110kV high-voltage electrical equipment use GIS; substation area is small; the increasing power system capacity caused short circuit current of grounding fault growing. The outstanding issues of substation grounding design is that the ground area is small (5000 ∼ 10000m2), and soil resistance rate is high (normally 500 ∼ 1200Ω · m or higher). There is no external ground conditions laid and local geological conditions are poor, and soil receptivity is high. Substation using reducing agent make the grounding grid of substation corroded very serious; soil around the net salinity and soil moisture make serious corrosion of the grounding.

articleTitle: A measurement and verification method for energy savings of power line transformation project
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Power line transformation projects, such as increasing diameter of lines, decreasing length of lines and boosting voltage level, are very common in power grid corporations. Besides meeting transmission capacity needs, these projects generate loss energy savings. Based on International Performance Measurement and Verification Protocol of efficiency valuation organization, this paper d is cusses a measurement and verification method for energy savings that generates from power line transformation projects, and gives details on how to measure parameters and calculate energy savings. The proposed method considers changes of operation situation after transformation, then a method by means of modifying baseline to solve transmission capacity varying are given in order to verify energy savings more objectively. Finally, uncertainty of the method is simply analyzed, as well as some points which might improve performance of the method further are described.

articleTitle: Application of conic programming for optimal distributed generation allocation in distribution network
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The widely application of distributed generation (DG) technologies poses new challenges to the operation and planning of the distribution network. Firstly, based on the basic DG allocation problem, a conic transformation model is proposed through variable substitution to realize the required format conversion, and then the conic programming(CP) algorithm is employed to acquire the optimal solution accurately, which also realizes the solving of power flow simultaneously. Finally, the optimal DG capacity obtained under different penetration levels and power factors are analyzed on the IEEE 33-node test feeder. Meanwhile, the validity of conic model as well as the CP algorithm is also verified.

articleTitle: A single-phase matrix algorithm for fault location of two-phase earthing fault in distribution systems
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: When two-phase earthing fault occurs in different sections of a feeder in a distribution system, part of section switches may have two phase fault current flowing through and part of section switches may have one phase fault current flowing through. So, fault current characteristic of this kind of fault is different from that of interphase short circuit fault. Then the traditional matrix algorithm will not be able to solve the fault location problem of this kind of fault. In order to solve the fault location problem, a single-phase matrix algorithm is put forward. This kind of fault has two fault phases and each fault phase has one single-phase fault information matrix. By multiplying each single-phase fault information matrix with the network describing matrix of the fault feeder, the single-phase fault judgment matrix of corresponding fault phase is generated. Both fault positions can be found by corresponding single-phase fault judgment matrixes.

articleTitle: The controlled splitting strategy for power system based on a decomposition algorithm
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
