abstract: As one of effective emergency control measures that are taken to keep the interconnected power grids from collapse caused by cascading failure, controlled splitting received broad recognition and approbation from engineering field and academic circle. The optimal controlled splitting problem is essentially an optimal graph splitting problem subjected to complicated topology constraints and large-scale, nonlinear constraints. In this paper, a complete model of the optimal controlled splitting of the power system is proposed, and a new decomposition algorithm searching for optimal splitting strategy was proposed. The complete model was converted into coupling sub-problems: graph partition problems and optimal power flow problem. The graph partition problem is solved by CGKP(Connected Graph Constrained Knapsack Problem) algorithm. Load and generation power adjustment variables are taken as transfer variables between the sub-problems. The results of the samples demonstrate the validity of the new model and method.

articleTitle: Calculation of distribution cable steady and transient temperature field in ducts
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the increasing consumption of power cable in urban areas, its ampacity becomes a hot research spot. At present, lots of researches about ampacity and temperature field concentrate on one single-core cable. However, pluralities of cables are laid intensively in duct banks for a real power system. Compared to single cable, if several cables are running at the same time, those cables' temperature and ampacity are affected by each other leading to low ampacity. Usually, existing ampacity standards are formulated by experience and not comprehensive enough for different regions. Therefore, it's a huge and urgent demand to determine transient temperature field distribution of different laying theoretically. In this paper, in order to meet the huge demand, a temperature field model of cable group is worked out via the finite element method (FEM) and calculated by load current curves in real power system. Dispatcher and maintenance personnel can determine the ampacity reasonably to ensure safety for dispatching and management.

articleTitle: Fault ride-through capability improvement of DFIG-based wind generation by employing a flux compensation type fault current limiter
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In this paper, taking the doubly fed induction generator (DFIG) based wind power application as a research objective, its fault ride-through (FRT) capability with a flux compensation type fault current limiter (FCL) is investigated. Since this kind of FCL can not only suppress fault current quickly, but also restrain voltage drop effectively, installing the FCL in the stator side of a DFIG can potentially help to enhance the transient performance of the DFIG. For this reason, some related theoretical analyses are conducted, and quantitative simulation verification is carried out through MATLAB/SIMU LINK. From the results, owing to the introduction of the FCL, the fault currents flowing through the DFIG can be limited to lower levels, and meanwhile the terminal voltage of the DFIG can be maintained. It is concluded that the FRT capability is availably improved for the wind turbine generator connected to power grid.

Author Keywords: Flux compensation type fault current limiter

articleTitle: A study of load characteristic of the building heating and cooling system in smart distribution grid
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The load of air conditioner has taken a significant percentage of whole social load. The paper firstly constructed a four-node electrical circuit to model the thermal behaviour of a building. And the four-node electrical circuit model was verified by a professional commercial software. Then the loads of heating and cooling systems installing on buildings with different thermal integrity levels were simulated by the four-node electrical circuit model. The results proved that the four-node electrical circuit is able to effectively identify the load characteristics of heating and cooling systems installing on different buildings.

articleTitle: Simulation study on inrush current in the context of CCHP systems based black-start units
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Scattered installation characteristic of CCHP system endows itself as a very favorable black-start unit, where inrush current plays as a significant factor in the process of black-start which need to be analyzed. To mirror the act of inrush current in such a case, the CCHP system based black-start model is established using the PSCAD simulation tool. In order to unveil the inrush current activity in an all-round way, the model is simulated in multiple circumstances embodying diversified CCHP systems and transformers, to move further, it is also extended to the stepping up from zero test. It is affirmative that the simulation findings will be significantly valued for the plan and design of CCHP systems where it is potentially served as a standby black-start unit.

articleTitle: Research on advanced sensor network based Cyber-Physical System for the Smart Grid
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Cyber Physical System will greatly improve the deep integration of power system and information system and thereby realize the real-time sensing, dynamic control and information service of Smart Grid. In this paper we summarize approaches of CPS as well as the on-line monitoring needs for the Smart Grid. We also present an advanced sensor network to meet the demand of the on-line monitoring applications. Furthermore, we propose an advanced sensor network based Cyber-Physical System for the Smart Grid.

articleTitle: Research on distribution network planning based on life cycle cost
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Life cycle asset management is one of the most significant concepts of modern distribution network planning. The paper firstly elaborates the basic concept of life cycle cost (LCC) of distribution network planning. Then a distribution network life cycle cost model, considering the initial investment, operation, maintenance and disposal costs, is constructed with the 10kV medium voltage power line for example, and the meanings of each sub-cost in this model are also analyzed. Then, the concept of life cycle cost is applied to the distribution network planning in Tangshan City, Hebei Province. Different planning solutions in two examples picked in class A and class B power supply regions are researched by life cycle cost method. By comprehensively comparing with the two planning solutions in annual cost, life cycle cost and reliability cost, the optimal planning solution of distribution network in two power supply regions is proposed, and the effectiveness of the life cycle cost model in distribution network planning is confirmed.

articleTitle: Distribution grid efficiency assessment grading research based on AHP
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Improving the grid efficiency level is a major way to achieve economic operation and sustainable development of the power grids. Previous studies on power industry energy conservation are much concentrated on supply side or large power grid, while energy conservation study on distribution side is still in its infancy. Studies have shown that the loss of distribution grid accounts for 3/4 of the total power loss owning to its complex structure and poor reliability, which implies that it may have a larger space in terms of energy efficiency improvements. As a result, assessing the energy efficiency of distribution grid, improving the energy efficiency of distribution process, and quantifying the energy efficiency which could be enhanced accurately, will have a guiding significance to power industry energy conservation. Fully considered and analyzed the characteristic of the distribution grid, this paper divides it by region. After studying the currently available energy-saving means of distribution grid, this paper provides a total of 9 energy-saving measures. Since regional distribution grids may have diverse characteristics, different indicator has various effects on distribution grid energy conservation. And the integrated energy- saving effect of all those measures will be the result of distribution grid energy efficiency assessment. According to the principle of AHP, this paper utilizes scoring method to reflect the different effects arising from various energy saving measures. Then comes to the distribution grid efficiency assessment scores. According to the scores, the energy saving potential of distribution grid is divided into four levels. And the grids of higher level will be placed in higher priority when distribution gird energy-saving transformation happens. In this paper, a city of Liaoning Province in low voltage distribution grid works as an example of energy efficiency evaluation, whose energy-saving plan fully not only demonstrates the accuracy and reasonability of assessment conclusions, but also verifies the effectiveness and practicality of the index system. The results based on energy saving potential assessment of distribution grid will provide a theoretical basis for regional distribution grid transformation programs, and then promote the construction and development of distribution grid energy conservation.

articleTitle: Optimization control of active distribution network based on Photovoltaic forecast information
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the cost declining of Photovoltaic (PV) power generation and the support of government, it can be expected that a large number of PV systems will be accessed to the distribution network in the future. The development of active distribution network provides a good solution to improve the intermittent energy consumptive ability of distribution network. Active distribution network is able to control the controllable units flexibly and effectively. Thus it can achieve optimal operation ensuring system stability and power quality. Based on the existing optimization strategies, this paper proposed two kind optimal strategies according to time scale, long-term comprehensive optimization (in 24 hours) and short-term real-time optimization (in 15 to 30 minutes), to achieve the most economical operation within one day with real-time error correction. Here considering PV power generation as one kind intermittent energy source accessed to the distribution network, long-term optimization needs daily loads and PV systems daily forecast information and short-term real-time optimization needs the ultra short-term forecast of the PV system. Considering the computing time and prediction accuracy, this paper applied PV system grey prediction methods (GM (1, 1)). At last, this paper verified the economical and effective characters of the optimization control strategy by a proper case.

Author Keywords: optimization control of active distribution network

articleTitle: Active distribution network layered and distributed control strategy & implementation
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the high penetration of distributed energy resource (DER) and energy storage system, the real-time performance of centralized management is really poor. In this paper, a multi-layered model is proposed to implement the control of active distribution network (ADN) in different time scales. The indicator of feeder control error (FCE) is used to represent deviation between real-time operating status and global optimized status. According to the layered and distributed control strategy, the regional controller model is established as a host of autonomous region. The constant feeder exchange power mode, regional autonomous control mode and regional cooperative control mode are put forward to adapt to different occasions. The effectiveness and reliability of ADN layered and distributed control strategy is verified by theoretical analysis and simulation.

articleTitle: A life cycle cost-effectiveness assessment model for power transformer selection based on grey correlation analysis
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The investment of a power transformer plays an important role in power equipment investment. Researchers have been focused on one-time cost of transformers while the future cost and benefit had been ignored. The life cycle cost (LCC) of a transformer was defined as the total cost through its whole life. Researches show that cost and effectiveness of the equipment are unity of opposites, and selecting the best investment program based on both cost and effectiveness can avoid financial losses. Factors that influence transformer's Life Cycle Cost relate to and also constrain each other. In this study, these factors are simplified as the economic factor and efficiency factor, and the main indices are chosen in the two factors. According to the above factors and indices, a three-level index system of quantitative and qualitative factors was established. Evidential reasoning was applied to quantify the qualitative indices. However, transformer investment evaluation is full of uncertainty as it is hard to obtain accurate and useful cost effectiveness results. The cost-effectiveness evaluation model in this study used grey correlation analysis for the power transformer selection. The results from this study show that the proposed approach is effective and offers a new approach to evaluating transformer investment.

articleTitle: Compound flexible control strategy for magnetically controlled shunt reactor suppressing overvoltage
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The paper proposed a compound flexible control strategy of magnetically controlled shunt reactor in shedding load situation, which can full-capacity input in time of heavy load line trip, then adjust to the specified value adaptively and flexibly. The proposed control strategy was analyzed and compared to the traditional control strategy in project application in the paper, which can not only suppress the frequency over-voltage of capacitive voltage rise in load shedding, reduce the system impulse and over-voltage duration, but also improve the voltage control accuracy, avoid overregulation. Example simulation was conducted to analyze and compared the effectiveness of proposed control strategies to traditional one, which confirmed the validity of compound flexible control strategy.

articleTitle: Research on the stator end vibration characteristics of large generator sets
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper describes the parameterized modeling method of the stator end of large turbine generator units. The parametric expressions are given for the end windings of the upper and lower layers, etc. The 3D assembly model of generator stator end with adjustable parameters is established, so that the selection of model structure components and the modification of geometric parameters can be quickly and simply completed for the model. Furthermore, through the ANSYS software. this article analyzes the influences of various parameters on the vibration characteristics of the stator end, including the geometrical parameters, support parts, boundary conditions and material parameters. The results show that most of the parameters have little influence on main vibration shapes, but have obvious influence on natural frequencies. The effects of the parameters on the vibration modes are summarized in this paper. The model can be conveniently used for the analysis of natural vibration characteristics either in generator structure design phase or for different types of generator units. And it lays the foundation for the analysis of the electromagnetic vibration of the stator end windings.

articleTitle: Study on drawing and modeling of Distribution Automation System based on GIS
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper is focus on application of Geographic Information System (GIS) in Distribution Management System (DMS). The difficulty has been analyzed, and the solution has been found. GIS and DMS are two kinds of computer application software. They are different in data structures and data transmission protocols. As a result, they can not doing data exchange directly. It must be realized data exchange between these two systems, if GIS can be applied in DMS. Through study on the standards IEC 61970 series and IEC 61968 series, it found that IEC 61970 has been defined Common Information Model (CIM) which solves the problem of different data structures of different systems, and IEC 61968 has been defined interfaces for the major elements of an interface architecture for DMS which provides a method of data exchange between GIS and DMS. After the GIS data has been converted to the DMS data based on IEC 61970 and IEC 61968, integrality and validity of the received data in DMS need checking. The right data writes into DMS database, and the wrong data sends back to GIS for modification. Based on the DMS database, Automatic Mapping (AM) can be done which saves time and improves work efficiency. All of the studies in this paper has been used in practice, and achieved favorable effect.

articleTitle: Research on theoretical line loss calculation of low-voltage power distribution area in Shanghai
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: On the basis of analyzing and comparing current theoretical line loss calculation of low-voltage power distribution area, back/forward sweep algorithm is selected and improved by considering the influence of power loss correction from node voltage and introducing three-phrase unbalance factor to branch shape factor. It is verified that the improved algorithm has higher accuracy and applicability in comparison of equivalent resistance algorithm and traditional back/forward sweep algorithm with 20 randomly selected computable distribution areas, which contributes to the task of further theoretical line loss calculation of low-voltage power distribution area in Shanghai.

articleTitle: Research of substation area protection test based on relay protection collaborative testing system
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Substation area protection application is one of the significant characteristics of the new generation smart substation. Substation area protection, contains BZT devices, line protections and bus differential protections in a set, provides redundancy for in situ protections. Higher requirements is put forward for collaborative work performance between different types and manufactures of protections as the highly integrated nature of substation area protection. This paper presents a new substation area protection method based on intelligent relay-protection collaborative testing system(IRPCTS). SCD file matches, GOOSE virtual terminal associated characteristics and coordination work performance between IED devices have been verified by the simple bus protection testing based on IRPCTS platform.

articleTitle: Island partition of the distribution system with distributed generation based on improved dynamic programming
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: A novel optimal island partition model of the distribution system with distributed generation (DG) is proposed and a distributed islanding method based on improved dynamic programming is applied to this model. This paper changes the islanding problem into minimum spanning tree to obtain connected graph. Since the load priority, controllable/uncontrollable load, and the restrictions of power balance, voltage and equipment capability are all taken into account, therefore, the proposed model and method can meet the demand of the practical engineering very well; Based on inclusion-exclusion theorem and dynamic programming theory, the distribution system containing DGs is divided into multiple tree knapsack problems. It effectively reduces the overlap between the various issues intersect. Each TKP is solved by the improved dynamic programming method. Through the island merging process, it can achieve the optimal division of the island. The numerical examples show that: the algorithm can improve the speed and accuracy of problem solving.

articleTitle: Low voltage ride-through test for two-level photovoltaic grid-connected inverter based on RT-LAB
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The low voltage ride-through (LVRT) grid-connected performance test of the controller of two-level photovoltaic grid-connected inverter is studied by RT-LAB hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) simulation technology, and a HIL modeling and testing scheme is presented for photovoltaic grid-connected inverter LVRT performance. First, a HIL LVRT test platform, which contains PV array model, voltage sag generator model and photovoltaic inverter power circuit model, is constructed by RT-LAB simulator. Furthermore, a LVRT control strategy under the asymmetric sag fault of grid voltage is designed. Finally, the LVRT HIL simulation test for a 500kW photovoltaic grid-connected inverter using the LVRT control strategy is done in different sag depths and different conditions by RT-LAB simulator, LVRT simulation test results show that the HIL modeling and testing scheme could simulate the on-site testing platform and the proposed control strategy has good dynamic, static characteristics in LVRT process.

articleTitle: The impact analysis of current transformer's saturation to relay protection
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper gives a full elaboration to the types and fundamentals of the current transformer's saturation, whose impact to all kinds of relay protection device has also been analyzed. Furthermore, an example of a high voltage line's over-grade tripping failure in a substation, which was caused by current transformer's saturation, is dissected. The research of the impact analysis will offer some basis for correctly judging, finding and settling the above mentioned failure in the future.

articleTitle: An analytic hierarchy process based method for identifying coherent generator groups
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: To solve the subjective and one-sidedness problems in the process of coherency identification, more factors are taken to account to analyze the coherency of generators. Using the experience of analytic hierarchy process for reference, a practical AHP model is set up, which combines key factors such as swing curves, topological structures, parameters of the generators and so on, in order to change the process of coherency identification from single-decision making to multiple attribute decision making. Through the coherence of the standards system known homology matrix and its similarity comparison and analysis of the matrix calculation, various factors comprehensive analytic hierarchy judgment matrix is determined, a relatively objective factors to determine the weight. Distributed clustering method is used to calculate similarity matrix, in the end to complete motor clustering. Simulation results of IEEE118-bus and West Inner Mongolia Power Grid show that this method is accurate and practical.

articleTitle: A operational optimization model for wind power and pumped-storage plant based on stochastic programming
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Based on the day-ahead forecast of system load and wind power output. A joint operation of pumped-storage and wind power plants model is built with the purpose of minimizing the system operation cost. In order to achieve the higher system flexibility and reduce the impact of volatility of wind power, pumped-storage units are incorporated into the unit commitment (UC) problem with wind power. The UC problem of the joint operation of pumped-storage and wind power plants is formulated as the mixed-integer convex program, which is optimized by Cplex. Conducted on a ten-unit system simulation, we can get the conclusion that the joint operation of pumped-storage and wind power plants is effective to reduce the impact of volatility of wind power on the power grid operation. At the same time, economic benefit is remarkable.

articleTitle: Robust state estimation for distribution networks based on residual prediction
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In order to improve the calculation accuracy and speed of distribution networks state estimation, this paper presents a robust algorithm of three-phase state estimation for distribution networks based on residual prediction. All kinds of measurements in distribution networks are used in the algorithm, jacobian matrix becomes constant though phase transform of node voltage and branch current, and equivalent transform of current amplitude measurement, the amount of calculation is reduced due to jacobian matrix remains unchanged in the iterative process. Setting of quivalent weight based on prediction residual avoids the unnecessary iterations in the correction of the equivalent weight, which reduces the amount of computation. Simulation results have shown the proposed method in this paper is stable and robust.

articleTitle: Research on active voltage stability of distribution network based on the bifurcation theory
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Voltage control faces severe challenges owing to the access of the large number of distributed generation in the active power distribution network. The start and development process of voltage instability or collapse and related mathematical conditions were eager to know. Active distribution network is a typical nonlinear nonautonomous systems, Bifurcation theory one of the effective way solving the nonlinear dynamic system was adopted to do a study on voltage instability or collapse in the active power distribution network. Here, the influence of the filter reactor of the micro power interface and reactive load on voltage stability were analyzed, which provided help to understand voltage instability and its boundary conditions. Simulation analysis shows that under the given conditions, With the increase of the filter reactance value, the active power distribution network bifurcated; With the increase of reactive load, the public bus voltage reduced, then active power was in a state of voltage instability. The simulation results are consistent with theoretical analysis. Bifurcation theory can be also applyed in influence of other parameters in the active power distribution network upon voltage stability, its physical concept and the details are clear, the conclusion can provide reference for researchers engaged in the power grid stability.

articleTitle: Economic operation analysis of energy storage system based on echelon-use batteries
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Two aspects are concerned, which is returned battery resulting waste of resources and recycling high utilization costs, as well as the impacts on the grid from electric vehicle fast charging. This paper presents a method for optimal allocation of electric vehicles echelon-use batteries and fast charging stations combined. According to the typical fast charging station load, analyzed that is the costs of using energy storage systems operation and maintenance, and the profits of delaying the distribution network upgrade, peak load shifting and reducing network losses. Economic model based on energy storage system is established, which realize the extended value of returned battery and fast charging stations economy of operation.

articleTitle: Assessment index of wind power capacity credit
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: As wind power penetration increases rapidly, reasonable assessment of wind power capacity credit becomes an important aspect of power system. Considering output characteristics of wind generators, an assessment model of wind power capacity credit based on Monte-Carlo simulation is established in the paper. The most commonly-used assessment indexes of wind power capacity credit are effective load carrying capability, equivalent firm capacity and equivalent conventional capacity. The wind power capacity credit under different assessment indexes is calculated in IEEE-RTS test system. The method to choose appropriate assessment index is given by analysis of the simulation results and the practical application.

articleTitle: Modeling and performance assessment of PV plants based on field-test of power generation unit
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: PV power plants should meet technical requirements before connected to grid. Due to the equipment capacity and cost constraints, low voltage ride through (LVRT) of the plants can not be directly tested. In this paper, the methods to assess PV plants performance based on the field test of power generation unit (PGU) are introduced. At first, the way to test LVRT capability of PGU is put forwarded, and then modeling and model correction is developed with t DIgSILENT Power- Factory. After the correction of PGU model, the whole PV plants model is built, including a mount of inverters, transformers, PV arrays, cabbles and other key components. The LVRT performance of PV plants is evaluated by the simulation result.

articleTitle: Implementation of web services for IEC61968 message conformance test
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Non-standardization of messages when using IEC61968 messages to fulfill information integration of DMS often causes interoperation failures and affects related works. Effective rules and methods to test IEC61968 messages are deficient now. To solve this problem, layered rules along with a metadata & rule-driven framework of IEC61968 message conformance test are proposed. An extensible & loosely-coupled web services architecture for conformance test is designed and implemented based on the framework, too. The validity of the software is proved by a use case.

articleTitle: The analysis of power deploy in holidays
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In this paper, based on the reality that holiday load is in a “trough” segment relative to the annual load curve, we intend to set up a preferential price during the holidays, through economic levers to encourage some industrial enterprises to go into operation in order to achieve the effect of valley filling. We can calculate the preferential price when achieving the target the electricity enterprises expect to fill the valley through the model.

articleTitle: Research on networking strategy and optimization simulation of process level network in smart substation based on OPNET
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: To verify the rationality of networking and the real-time reliability of network transmission for the process level in smart substation, this paper proposes a method of modeling and simulating for smart substation based on OPNET, which models the key network equipments after analyzing the simulation requirement of process level network in smart substation. And several networking modes and optimization strategies for packet transmission are researched. Then the simulation example of Qinyun Substation is used to prove the rationality and effectiveness of the networking strategy, combined with static multicast and different star networks for SV and GOOSE packets, in the practical engineering application. It is certified that the networking strategy meets the applied requirement about the network flow and transmission delay of process level network in smart substation at the moment.

articleTitle: Research on lightning protection of distribution network overhead insulated line
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In recent years, disconnection issues have become increasingly prominent along with the city distribution network insulating. This paper reviewed some main methods of disconnection prevention caused by lightning, and the mathematical derivation breakage mechanism was analyzed. On this basis, this paper introduces several new measures to prevent insulated wire breaking caused by lightning, including using overvoltage protector, puncture protection fittings and lightning protection composite insulator. The author suggested that the appropriate preventive measures should be selected according to the situation.

articleTitle: A novel pilot protection scheme for distribution network with DGs
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the rapid interconnection of a large number of distributed generations(DGs), new challenges for protection of distribution network are posed. Three-section current protection will be no longer applied due to the change of structure of distribution network. To date, the majority of the solutions are adding directional elements or using differential protection scheme of high-voltage transmission. The former requires additional voltage transformer, the latter requires communication channel of high synchronization. However, that can not be realized in distribution network of low voltage. In allusion to the low voltage distribution network (weak communication, lacks of enough voltage transformer), this paper proposes a novel pilot protection scheme based on positive sequence current phase. Firstly, phase variation is obtained by compare the phase of sequence current before and after fault. Then, internal fault and external fault can be determined by compare phase variation of two terminals. Compared with traditional phase comparison pilot protection, this scheme only needs to transmit numerical value of phase variation, therefore communication channel of high synchronization is not required; compared with the traditional directional comparison pilot protection, this scheme only needs to collect current information, therefore there is no need for additional voltage transformer. Simulation proves the validity and superiority of proposed pilot protection scheme.

articleTitle: Research and application of new type fault indicator in smart distribution grid
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This research comes from national 863 project (2011AA05A114), it introduces the application of fault indicator in the smart distribution system, the research analyses the fault indicator principle, raises some new ideas and solutions for the fault indicator using In fault locating system from the distribution automation development in the smart grid building.

articleTitle: The field calibration method of electronic current transformer in intelligent substation
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The measurement accuracy of electronic current transformer (ECT) is related to correctly measure power energy, but the research on the field calibration methods of ECT is very little. The distribution of ECT in intelligent substation in china is introduced. According to the technical standards of GB/T 20840.7-Electronic Current Transformer, the field calibration method of ECT is proposed based on current comparative methods. The proposed field calibration method is used the communication protocol IEC 61850. The ratio difference f and angle difference δ of tested ECT can be directly obtained from the electronic transformer calibrator. The current working principle of primary devices and the operation method of primary devices are described in detail, when using the proposed field calibration methods. Meanwhile the secondary basic principle and working mechanism of the proposed method is studied. The field calibration results not only demonstrate the effectiveness and accuracy of this paper's content, but also show that the tested ECTs can be used 0.2S level power meter transformers. The research results of this paper can provide technical supporting for the commissioning and maintenance of power energy metering in intelligent substation.

articleTitle: Research of regional power grid operation comprehensive quantitative evalution system and intelligent security early warning system
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Regional power grid operation comprehensive quantitative evaluation system and intelligent security early warning system based on SCADA/EMS is presented. The operation status of the grid is evaluation from capacity, quality and economy. By studying on substation and important customer evaluation, N-1 scan and load transfer, the intelligent security early warning system is fulfilled, which achieves the integration functions of real-time monitoring, analyse and evaluation, security warning and decision support.

articleTitle: Environmental corrosiveness evaluation and corrosion charactistics analysis of power transmission and transformation equipment
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: To explore mechanism and law of corrosion by analyzing the possible environmental factors (air, soil, etc.) that might cause corrosion and corrosion product of electric power facility and metal components of transformer substation, and to establish corrosion environment evaluation method and to predict the corrosion behavior of transmission and transformation equipment in environment according to the influence of corrosion of various factors on different power equipment, so as to provide reference basis for engineering design as well as selection and corrosion prevision of structure and materials.

articleTitle: A stochastic optimization modeling and algorithmic strategy for the security constrained unit commitment with wind farm
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: We address the problem of security constrained unit commitment (SCUC) with power flow constraints, capturing the uncertainty of wind power and demands. We propose a modeling and algorithmic strategy based on the framework of approximate dynamic programming (ADP). A stochastic optimization model is developed for the SCUC problem with power flow constraints. We demonstrate the methodology using both stochastic and deterministic formulations of the SCUC problem. Th is paper describes the handling of power flow constraints and different sources of uncertainty. The application on IEEE-30 to -300 bus systems and a Polish-2737 bus test system fully validate the effectiveness of the ADP-based modeling and algorithmic strategy.

articleTitle: Reducing outages in distribution by testing recloser controls
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Reclosers and distribution automation solutions have been increasingly implemented into the distribution network in the utilities in East Asia and Western Pacific countries. Recloser controls nowadays offer many functions that are similar to the protection relays in the substation. This paper aims at stating the increasing need of advanced recloser control system in modern power system, and further extends the discussion to explain the importance and convenience of testing recloser controls during commissioning and maintenance in the field.

articleTitle: Unified information modeling and application for distribution production maintenance platform based on CIM
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The development of smart grid has raised higher demand on maintenance ability and resource allocation of power distribution production, where an unified information model is necessary for integrating various application systems. This paper extends distribution information model through differentiation analysis on the basis of current standard CIM model. Meanwhile, the standard IEC 61968 XSD message was extended to meet the requirements of information exchange in distribution production maintenance operation flow extracted from extended model. Finally, information interaction is realized through ESB using generic WSDL structure and standard SOAP binding.

articleTitle: Reliability assessment for micro-grid with multi-energy demand
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Micro-grid can take the full advantages of the distributed renewable resources and improve the reliability of the power supply. The prerequisite is that the planned micro-grid itself should be well designed and its operation safety should be guaranteed. The intermittency characteristics of the Distributed Generators (DGs) could have negative impact on the reliability of the micro-grid. However, if expanding the application of micro-grid is at large-scale, it is necessary to develop the reliability assessment method which can evaluate the multi-energy micro-grid. This paper proposes a reliability assessment method for evaluating the reliability of the micro-grid. To address the complexity of micro-grid running modes and the randomness of the component fault occurrences, the Monte-Carlo method has been applied. Meanwhile, one micro-grid scenario was built. The simulation results have verified the validity of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Real-time simulation and parameter optimization for SVC control tragedy of XiZang grid
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Since Qingzang HVDC system put into operation in 2011, higher requirements for voltage stability in Xizang grid must be taken into account. It plans to install several SVC devices at three 220 kV stations which include Duodi, Naiqiong and QuGe, in order to improve the voltage quality of Xizang Grid and the transmission capacity of QingZang HVDC system. To optimize and validate the control tragedy of these SVCs before their installation, a real-time digital/analog hybrid simulation platform is setup by HYPERSIM. This platform is composed of a digital model which includes detail 220 kV and 110 kV network of XiZang grid, an analog HVDC controller for Qingzang HVDC system, and all the analog SVC controllers. It includes two types of SVC devices for the real project, one is TCR+SC, and another is TSC. Based on the simulation platform, the SVC control tragedies of these two types are validated respectively. The simulation results show: through adding SVC devices at the 220 kV stations, the Xizang grid has better voltage recover characteristic after short-circuit fault. It can draw a conclusion that the voltage control tragedy used in this real project has favorable control characteristic for the voltage stability of Xizang Grid.

articleTitle: An accident analysis of a smart substation
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This article records and analyses an accident happened in a 500kV smart substation, which was caused by a single-phase ground fault happened to a 500kV transmission line in the power grid. The accident provoked false action of the differential protection of main transformer, false action of the differential protection of 220kV bus and false action of line differential protection of several 220kV transmission lines. The accident caused the power losing of transformer, several 220kV transmission lines and 220kV north bus. Through the analysis of the fault wave of the tripping devices, we know that these false actions of differential protections were caused by the un- synchronism of sampled data of current of 220kV equipments supplied by merging units. This accident show the importance of the synchronism of sample data, so it's an essential step to examine synchronism of the MUs in the smart substation before it puts into operation.

articleTitle: Unit commitment based on fuzzy chance constraints in time-of-use price
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: As implementation of time-of-use (TOU) price would result in peak cutting and valley filling, economical efficiency of unit commitment could be improved. Based on consumer psychology model, varying pattern of responding deviation under TOU was analyzed in this paper. According to credibility theory, the curve of fitting load was described by fuzzy parameter. Thus a model of unit commitment was established, of which the credibility chance constraints could be turned into equivalent forms for solution. Case study on IEEE 118-bus test system had verified the positive effects of TOU, and comprehensiveness of unit commitment decision could be improved when considering uncertainty.

articleTitle: Distribution automation system modeling based on information sharing
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Distribution management system consists of distribution automation system, superior dispatching automation system, production management system, GIS, marketing management system, 95598 customer service system, etc. By means of information sharing and function integration between the related systems, the related functions such as outage management, user interaction and access control of distributed powers could be implemented. The implementation of model maintenance at source-side, information sharing, which could solve the problems of repeated modeling and information island, has a very important significance for the construction of the distribution network system. IEC 61970 and IEC 61968 provide with standards and technical directions for system interconnection and information sharing in the distribution network system. Because of various distribution devices and wirings, distribution modeling methods will have some difference in detail in each system. The distribution automation system could share the device parameters in dispatching automation system and G IS system, but in order to ensure the rapidity of network topology analysis and the correctness of feeder fault location, the topology model and graphics exported from the GIS system couldn't be used directly in distribution automation system. In addition, distribution network modified frequently which leads to frequent modeling of distribution network in China, so it is important to maintain the model consistency between distribution automation system and G IS system. This paper proposed an expansion method of C IM in distribution automation system, recommended the concept of the circuit and feeder group, introduced the steps of distribution model splicing by use of the power dispatching automation system and GIS system model, and introduced the model synchronization method in generating a distribution expansion model and maintain related systems. In this way, we en sure the mod el source-side maintenance and meet the requirement of DAS applications. The actual application in some DAS projects shows that the extension of standard C IM model and the model method based on information sharing are effective and practical.

articleTitle: Empirical analysis on model and parameters of grid-connected Direct-driven Wind Turbine Generators in transient stability computation
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The precision of model and parameter of Wind Turbine Generator are of crucial importance for the research on the influence of grid-connected wind power generation on power grid. In order to research dynamic behaviour of grid-connected Direct-driven Wind Turbine Generator(DWTG) during large disturbance and obtain parameters of DWTG that can reflect actual condition. Large scale disturbance test located in Jiuquan wind power base in Gansu Province is performed by the Northwest of China Power Grid Company. Base on disturbance test data of wind farm, applying the Electromechanical transient model of DWTG in Power System Analysis Software Package (PSASP) platform, the empirical analysis on model and parameters of DWTG simulation is conducted. By full use of the improved control strategy of the DWTG model, key parameters of the wind turbine are proposed and the sensitivity analyses on them are carried out. According to on-site testing data, related parameters of the simulation platform are modified to make the simulation curve more approximating to the measured curve, thus the precision of DWTG model is improved.

articleTitle: Study on low frequency oscillation suppression of PV generation based on reactive power modulation
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With fast development of large-scale photovoltaic (PV) power generation, the effect on low frequency oscillation caused by PV has been received widespread attention, and the use of low frequency oscillation suppression through PV has become a focus of current researches. In the paper, the feasibility of PV generation to suppress the low frequency oscillation is analyzed firstly, secondly, the effect of PV integration into a power system is analyzed, then an additional controller is designed to stabilize the low frequency oscillation with reference to the conventional PSS structure, and last, a chain system is established on DIgSILENT PowerFactory software, control effects both with and without the designed controller to stabilize the low frequency oscillations are simulated, and the results show that the designed controller could improve the small-signal stability of the power system

articleTitle: Measurement method of harmonics and inter-harmonics with nonsynchronous sampling in IEC framework
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper focus on harmonics and inter-harmonics with nonsynchronous sampling in IEC 61000-4-7 standard framework measurement problem, proposed the group measurement method and accurate measurement method of harmonics and inter-harmonics, and through removing the leakage value of other components on the concerned lines to eliminate interference of other components, solved the problem of adjacent harmonics and inter-harmonics parameters accurate separation. DFT/FFT spectrum leakage occurred when nonsynchronous sampling in fundamental frequency, harmonics and inter-harmonics spectrum mutual interference affect the measurement results, the traditional interpolating windowed FFT method ignores the long-range leakage which came from other components on the concerned component. Firstly, the paper transformed the spectrum of Hanning weighted signal in IEC framework with nonsynchronous sampling, and adjusted the phase factor of spectrum, to change side lobes adjacent spectral phase difference of 180 degrees in other components, used the vector sum of adjacent lines to eliminate the long-range leakage on the concerned component, thereby proposed the group measurement method and accurate measurement method of harmonics and inter-harmonics, achieving harmonics and inter-harmonics specific parameters measurement. Based on that, proposed the harmonics and inter-harmonics separated method, and further successive removed the leakage value of other components on the concerned lines to improve the measurement accuracy, when nonsynchronous sampling without increasing the length of the sampling data, an effective solution to the harmonics and inter-harmonics cannot be accurately measured when closely spaced separation problem. Through the simulation of 10 cycles nonsynchronous sampling data, with other components and noise interferences, achieved a separation measure of 150.3Hz harmonics and adjacent 152.1Hz inter-harmonics under 5Hz frequency resolution, the relative errors are less than 0.01%, and validated real-time and effective characteristics of the proposed methods in IEC framework.

articleTitle: Research on influencing factors of distributed generation system
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In order to make full use of renewable energy, it needs to be based on different conditions to optimize the type selection of distributed generation system. The natural resources, load level and fuel prices should be considered. This paper constructs the structure of generally stand-alone distributed generation system and discusses the key factors influencing type selection. In the case of ensuring the reliability of power supply, the total net present cost (NPC) of distributed generation system is the optimizing goal. Homer software is used for simulation to optimize the types of the system. This article studies the natural resources, load level and fuel price. It also analyzes the effects of these factors on the optimal type. The results can provide a reference for engineering application, such as the optimal type and project planning of distributed generation system.

articleTitle: Evaluation method for impact on protection of distribution network with distributed electric resources
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Recent gradual improvement of the distributed electric resources (DER) penetration results in the change of original topology and power flow direction of distributed network. The short circuit current, which is provided by distributed electric resources, has changed the distributed network fault current both in size and distribution, will reduce the protection sensitivity, and bring negative impacts such as blinding and tripping. However, the actual structures of active distribution network are complex, it is difficult to measure the impact levels in traditional methods. These situations must be avoided. In this paper, the worst situations on protection are analyzed, an evaluation method based on maximum value of short circuit current provided by DER is proposed. The simulation with Matlab/Simulink software is introduced, the error sources of the method are analyzed, and the results indicate the feasibility and validity of the proposed method.

articleTitle: The analysis of power flow distribution in SpotNetwork with DG
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: with the rapid development of society, more and more attentions are paid to the reliability of power supply. Spot Network, which is a new power supply mode with high reliability, and its original protection configuration was introduced in this paper firstly. Then the law of power flow distribution in this mode with the connection of DG was analyzed emphatically and the relation between the source output and the source voltage, equivalent impedance, low voltage load and the DG output was deduced. Next, the condition for reverse output and the influence on protection caused by DG was analyzed theoretically. Last but not the least, the simulation by PSCAD software was done to justify the analysis above.

articleTitle: Analysis for the abnormal growth of bushing dielectric loss in a 500KV transformer
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In the preventive test of a imported 500kV transformer, defects are found in the neutral bushing and mid-voltage side bushing that the dielectric loss grows abnormally. The defective bushings are analysis with the method of dielectric loss comparison, high voltage dielectric loss test, frequency domain dielectric spectrum analysis. And the analysis result shows, the abnormal growth is caused by the defect that the capacitor core is not fully dried. The moisture permeates gradually and increases the power loss. Discovery of this defect lowers the risk of internal insulation breakdown caused by the large power loss and high temperature. Provide a new idea for defect judgment, and avoid long time power failure caused by malfunction of the bushing. It provides reference for the same bushing malfunction in the future.

articleTitle: Research on the network reconfiguration after distribution network fault
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: For the problem of the distribution network reconfiguration. This article describes the three network reconfiguration scheme. Adhere to the principle of “Step by Step” and gradually upgrade, the automation level of a system can be enhanced. The local intelligence mode is a foundation function, it is easy to implement without the communication system and the host station. On the basis of the local intelligence mode, it can automatically upgrade to distributed intelligence model and improve the automation level through adding the communication channels. When monitoring and controlling the line perfectly are needed or network structure is complex, the comprehensive automation of feeder can be realized by building the distribution control center and improving the channel of communication.

articleTitle: Influence on power quality by wind turbine's isolating operation
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Wind power generation is the most mature distributed power generation technology with most applications in the world. In this paper, it uses simulation software DlgSILENT to set up constant-speed Wind Turbine model based on common induction generator to study the influence on power quality of the load in generator's Isolating operation mode. Besides, it also studies its influence on distribution network voltage in Wind Turbine switching and obtains the corresponding conclusion.

articleTitle: A new type of intelligent terminal in distribution network based on the standard IEC61850
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper proposes a new type of intelligent distribution terminal based on IEC61850 standard, realizes the integration of multiple functions, meets the requirements of integration and modularization of data acquisition, transmission and control. Device uses the IEC61850 standard to regulate the terminal information modeling, information exchange and service mapping, self describing function and uses the IEC61850-6 standard, replacing remote manual configuration protocol point table and modify the work, improves the efficiency of debugging.

articleTitle: A new integrated design of smart transformer
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The development of smart transformers meets with some issues as mismatch interfaces between mechanical parts and electrical parts, non-standard function settings in smart components and other similar problems. To solve these issues, this paper proposed an integrated design based on the theory of integrated design, elaborating the design of transformer and sensor integration as well as transformer and smart component integration. And a simulation of the leakage current at the tap of capacitive bushing under different levels of voltage was conducted at the end of this paper, providing guide for future research.

articleTitle: Optimal control strategy of dual-active-bridge converter for battery energy storage system
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: As a core link of battery energy storage system (BESS) for grid-connection, the dual-active-bridge (DAB) converter has significant effects on the performance of the whole system. In order to address the mismatch voltage issue of DAB in BESS, an optimal control strategy is proposed. The paper discusses the operation principle of the circulating power, and analyzes the voltage, transmission power and current stress models. On this basis, the switching model of current stress is established, and the optimal modulation algorithm is proposed. At last, the prototype of the system is built to verify the theoretical analysis. Experimental results show that the optimal control strategy can reduce the current stress of the converter effectively.

articleTitle: A projective based dynamic simulation algorithm of active distribution networks
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The dynamic characteristics of active distribution networks (ADNs) need to be concerned if a large number of distributed generators are connected. A highly efficient and reliable dynamic simulation algorithm is therefore essential for the stability analysis of ADNs. This paper proposes a novel dynamic simulation algorithm of ADNs based on the projective integration method, which is a second-order explicit integration algorithm. The proposed method greatly improves the numerical stability of the traditional explicit algorithms and increases the efficiency significantly at the same time. It is especially suitable for the dynamic simulation and stability analysis of the ADNs with a large number of DGs. Case studies based on the IEEE 123-node test feeder show the effectiveness and efficiency of the proposed method, which is verified through the comparison with the commercial simulation tool DIgSILENT/PowerFactory.

articleTitle: SVG supplementary damping control for the dynamic stability of wind farm
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: A damping control strategy to improve the dynamic characteristics based on SVGs is proposed in this paper. The shaft model, induction generator model, converter control model and angle control model of DFIG (Doubly Fed Induction Generator) are presented. The alternating voltage control model and the voltage control model of SVGs (Static Var Generation) are built, the mathematical model of the damping control module is proposed. The dynamic stability after the integration of wind farm is detailed analyzed with two-area four-machine system example and the availability of this damping control strategy is also confirmed.

articleTitle: Development of low voltage ride through testing device for the grid-connected photovoltaic power station in high-altitude area
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: According to the newest published national standard, large-scale photovoltaic power station should meet the requirements of low voltage ride-through. In this paper, the low voltage ride through detection technology is investigated and the development scheme of detecting device for grid-connected photovoltaic power station in high-altitude area is also designed. Besides, the topology of detecting device and the testing methodology is illuminated. With impedance divider structure, fully automation design, the detecting device can implement multi-fold tests, which involve three-phase symmetrical drop test under 35kV or 10kV, two-phase interphase asymmetric drop test and single-phase grounding asymmetric drop test. The device is movable, with integrating all equipment in a closed container. The movability makes it very suitable for testing grid-connected photovoltaic in high-altitude area of northwest in China, which will ensure the grid-connecting quality of the photovoltaic power station and keep power grid running safely and stably.

articleTitle: Research on main transformer capacity configuration of 110∼35kv substation based on different power regions
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The grid characteristics significantly differ in various areas because of the broad region in China. The appropriate construction standards should b e researched according to the different supply regions. The main trans former capacity con figuration of 110~35kV substation is researched in the paper. The optimization method of main transformer capacity is proposed. The capacity optimization mathematical model is established which takes the lowest annual cost per unit area of power network as the objective function. And the corresponding grid models of different voltage levels are created. The main transformer capacities of 110~35kV substation are optimized according to the load characteristics of different supply regions and the final capacity configuration is proposed.

articleTitle: Application of Solid State Transfer Switch in emergency power supply vehicles
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In order to ensure high-reliability and high-security of the power supply for major politic, economic and culture activities, emergency power supply vehicle is often used to provide backup by power companies. Automatic Transfer Switch (ATS) is widely utilized to join the vehicle into power grid. The switching process lasts for a few seconds, during which power supply is shortly interrupted and the normal operation of sensitive load is affected. Although UPS power system can realize uninterruptible power supply for important users, its corollary equipment is relatively complex and diverse. Moreover, it's usually designed as an integrated structure and high-power UPS cannot be loaded on the vehicle. To overcome the shortcoming of current power supply vehicle and meet the uninterruptible large-capacity power supply demand in special period, this paper proposes two mobile power supply solutions based on Solid State Transfer Switch (SSTS). Application test shows that the designed power supply vehicle based on SSTS has multiple functions, reliable performance and strong practicability.

articleTitle: Multi-objective stochastic optimal day-ahead scheduling for micro-grid based on scenario and PSO
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In this paper, the multi-objective optimal scheduling problem of micro-grid is studied in an uncertain framework. The Probability Density Functions (PDF) and Roulette Wheel Mechanism (RWM) are used to build the scenarios, which can describe the randomness and uncertainty of wind power, photovoltaic power and load demand forecast error. The dual goals of economic and environmental are analyzed with the system constraints. Multi-objective Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) is used to coordinate them. Thus, a multi-objective stochastic optimization scheduling scheme is proposed based on scenario and PSO. Finally, in the simulation, the proposed framework is verified to be more effective compared with the deterministic framework for micro-grid.

articleTitle: Research on simulation of V / V connection transformer power quality
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: It is of significance for the research on traction power supply system power quality and the analysis on its impact on the grid to simulation of V / V traction transformer simulation. Based on this, a typical unbalance V / V traction transformer model and load model electric locomotives are created in PSCAD / EMTDC, SS9 electric locomotive is used when simulation. V/V traction transformer with the conditions of the electric locomotive traction load is simulated and electric locomotive load current harmonics and power quality PCC connection point properties are analyzed. Simulation results show that the proposed mode is effective.

articleTitle: A load management optimization approach considering economic efficiency and load profile
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Demand side management (DSM) is the planning, implementation and monitoring of those utility activities designed to influence customers' use of electricity in ways that will produce desired changes in the utility's load profile, especially for reducing the peak load. As a significant part of DSM, load management changes load profile by load shifting, load clipping, load translation and other methods. In the existing load management approaches, most of them simply focus on maximizing economic benefit or loading rate. To improve load management efficiency, this paper proposes a novel optimization approach, considering both economic efficiency and load shape, based on economy theory. Besides, several conversion methods are presented to turn the proposed mixed integer nonlinear programming model into nonlinear programming one in order to simplify the solving process. The simulation study shows that the proposed approach has the merits in economical efficiency and load profile improvement over the conventional method.

articleTitle: On-line monitoring and evaluation of mechanical characteristic condition of switchgear
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In this paper, through the monitoring case on the mechanical characteristics of the circuit breaker in service operation, analyzed the problems such as when the circuit breaker is in the running process whether is abnormal, potential faults or defect types, the potential fault parts, etc, and had a maintenance to the products with potential failures that may endanger the operation, and verified the potential fault diagnosis by the actual products. This paper uses the advanced on-line monitoring system of high voltage circuit breaker for monitoring circuit breaker closing and opening motions and current waveform of closing and opening coil, to obtain spring running state and monitoring the spring fatigue performance at any time. It solves the problem that the spring which is most important component of operating mechanism is difficult to monitoring in the running status. Meanwhile, we can determine common fault from the current waveform of closing/opening coil, such as whether the coil is binding or auxiliary switch is failures and so on. It provides effective guarantee of reliable safety runs for circuit breakers.

articleTitle: The influence of the EV charging station's large-scale access to the backbone network
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In order to study the load characteristics of the electric vehicle charging station and analyze the influence of the charging station's large-scale access to the regional power grid, the following measures have been taken: first, analysis of the modeling with power functions that is commonly used in the electric power system load modeling; second, analysis of the energy storage and charging systems' working principles and working modes; third, conversion of the two systems into a constant capacitive impedance load equivalent and a constant power load equivalent respectively and develop a power function model for each of them accordingly; fourth, use of the linear polynomial to express the charging station's mixed load model of bus voltage and frequency; fifth, test of the rationality of the mixed load model by comparing the daily load curves produced by the mixed load model and the MATLAB simulation model; finally, use of PSCAD simulation method to build a backbone n et work and connect the Shenzhen charging stations equivalent load to the backbone model bus. The result is that the large-scale access of charging stations equivalent load can cause a sudden drop in the bus voltage and frequency. Therefore, the developed mixed load model is of great significance to the study of load characteristics of charging stations and the impact of their great access to the backbone network on the network security and stability.

articleTitle: Reliability evaluation to converter transformers of 2×12-pulse UHVDC transmission system
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The converter transformers (CTs) between the AC system and the converters are necessary for reliable operation of the ultra high voltage DC (UHVDC) system. Compared with the traditional HVDC system, 2×12 pulse UHVDC system has more complicated configuration and more capacity levels; the CTs with Y/Y and Y/Δ connections can't be replaced by each other, adding difficulty to the reliability evaluation, which has not be fully investigated yet. In this paper, reliability of the CTs for UHVDC system is quantified using the State Space (SS) and Frequency & Duration (F&D) methods. The state spaces of the single-phase CTs with three- and two-windings are proposed. Six operating modes are defined for the CTs. The spare for the three- and two- winding CTs is considered. The two-winding CTs with Y/Y and Y/Δ connections are differentiated and modelled separately to reduce number of the states. The numerical results are compared with the existing literatures to show accuracy and advantage of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Research and DEVELOPMENT of NEW STYLE phase detector for high voltage switchgear based on phase difference
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In distribution network, when phase detector is made between two high voltage switchgear, with which the capacitive sensor indicators assorted are inconsistent, some problem like phase sequence detection misjudgment could occur. In order to solve this problem, phase difference method is proposed for the phase sequence detection between the two high voltage switchgears. This method has the versatility to judge accurately in phase detection. Actual test shows it could fully meet the phase dection requirements of high voltage switchgear.

articleTitle: A method for computing the short term flicker severity(Pst) based on EMD and TEO fluctuating feature extraction
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Traditional flicker detection of IEC needs design multiple filters, the process is complex and the computational burden is heavy. A method for computing the short term flicker severity based on EMD (empirical mode decomposition) and TEO (Teager energy operator) is proposed in this paper. It extracts voltage flicker envelop which captures the main flicker characteristic from the voltage signal of PCC(Point of Common Coupling) by using the dynamic phasor method. Then it divides flicker envelop of the non-stationary signal into several stationary components and negligible remaining with EMD, identifies the frequency and amplitude of each component with TEO and then computes the flicker severity of power consumer. The validity of the method is verified by simulation finally.

articleTitle: Study on the feeder topology modeling and IED configured methods for IEC61850
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: IEC61850 comprises complete data object modeling methods and consistent service interfaces, making the data interaction, function joint and interoperability among different terminals possible. Besides, its point to multipoint communication mode is very suitable for distributed intelligent feeder automation (FA) system that IP network based. Distributed intelligent FA is more and more valued and becoming to the trend because of its independence on the global information from the master station, fast fault process, better adaptability to the change of distribution grid, easier maintenance etc. In the applications of distributed intelligence FA, control functions are implemented based on the network topology information, such as power supply recovery has to know the location of the tie switch, island protection requires to track the trunk power, Load transfer must forecast the load bearing capacity. So, IEC61850 promoting to the field of distribution automation cannot avoid a key problem that how to clearly express the feeder connections/topologies among substations and configure them to related STUs. In this paper, the connectivity modes of medium voltage distribution feeder were analyzed ;the feeder equipment model and topology model were extended through the topology expressed methods of IEC 61968/61970 common information model (CIM); the SCL object model was put forward and the example cable ring network was partially described abiding by XML Scheme; Finally, several feasible methods by which the feeder topology configured to STUs were presented, as well as the comparison of their implementation effects. All of the above is to technically support the IEC61850 application for distributed intelligent FA.

articleTitle: Distribution networks distribution network condition based maintenance application present situation and development
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: From a background of domestic electric power enterprise distribution network state maintenance, State maintenance for the distribution network development status quo and the situation at home and abroad, Overhaul technology and management experience combined with state of the distribution network, Explore with g rid equipment condition based maintenance technology application and development in the future.

articleTitle: Study on hybrid storage method of AMI mass data
publicationTitle: 2014 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Currently, the data size of Advanced Metering Infrastructure (AMI) system is leaping rapidly. The traditional data storage solution in most AMI systems utilize Relational Data Base Management System (RDBMS) However, current RDBMS can hardly meet the requirements of high-speed storage, computation and analysis when faced with mass data, which places a huge limit on potential applications. This paper proposes a method that divides AMI system data into measurement data and management data according to their respective characteristics. The method utilizes a hybrid of Hadoop Distributed File System (HDFS) and RDBMS to sort and store data as well as to gain unified data access. A detailed classification, storage and extraction process and the system design are presented in the paper. Finally, a comparative test of typical AMI business scenario is carried out.
